Hello,

My Nexus L1 miner doesn't work anymore.

- I changed the powersupply without any result
- I changed the fused (with the spare one) without any result.

My order number: Order Shop····

Please provide me with instructions about the return policy.

--

[image: --]
Roy K.
[image: http://](contact hidden)
(contact hidden)

Hi Roy,

Thanks for already swapping the power supply and putting in the spare fuse. That rules out the two most common causes, so we can go straight to the unit itself. When a miner stops working, our hardware team looks at the fault first and then decides the next step. To give them everything in one go, please reply with the following.

First, tell me exactly what happens when you plug it in and switch it on. Does any LED light up, do the fans spin even briefly, and does anything show on a screen or in the web page? Or is there no sign of life at all?

Second, tell me about the fuse. Was the original fuse visibly blown (blackened, or with a broken wire inside)? Is the spare one still intact after you tried again, or did it blow as well?

Third, send a short video, 10 to 20 seconds, of the unit as you switch it on, with the power cable and the front of the miner in view.

Fourth, send a clear photo of the serial number label on the unit.

Please don't fit any more fuses for now. If you ever notice a burning smell, a pop or a hot plug, unplug it straight away and leave it unplugged.

As soon as I have these, I'll pass the full picture to our hardware team.

Best regards,
Hal, HeliumDeploy Technical Support

Hi Hal,

Thanks for your reply.

When I plug in the miner and switch it on, absolutely nothing happens. No fans spinning, no display, no LED lights — no signs of life at all.

I’ve attached photos of the fuses. The fuse with the grey background is the original fuse that was installed in the unit. The other one is the spare fuse.

I’ve also attached the requested video and a photo of the serial number label.

Please let me know what your hardware team finds and what the next steps are.

Best regards,
Roy S. from my iPhone

Note to the team: I sent Roy's Nexus L1 (Shop····) to the team as a likely hardware fault. Nothing goes to Roy from me. The chat is back with Sarah, who will tell him the team is reviewing the return, and JD or Georges approve or decline it. **Why it's a board fault:** The unit shows no sign of…
